newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia May trade balance 156.8 mln rgt surplus.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia May trade balance 156.8 mln rgt surplus.

text.p: Malaysia had a trade surplus of 156.8 million ringgit in May against a deficit of 2.12 billion in April, Acting Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim was quoted as saying on Saturday by the Bernama news agency.

In the first five months of the year, the country's trade balance was a surplus of 49.1 million ringgit against a deficit of 1.37 billion in the corresponding period of 1996, said Anwar, who is also Finance Minister.
He was speaking to reporters after a meeting of his ruling United Malays National Organisation party's supreme council.
Anwar did not give the breakdown of exports and imports.
